title: Order a measured filter cascade
description: Reorder deterministic gates and watch a fixed labeled cohort stop at its first failure. The retained set stays constant; stage calls, CPU work, and first-failure reasons change.
benchmarkNote: The base fixture contains 10,000 synthetic records. Per-call costs are explicit illustrative measurements from one test environment: contract 0.04 ms, duplicate 0.20 ms, quality 0.80 ms, and safety 2.40 ms. Replace them with measurements from your own payloads, models, hardware, and batch sizes.

stages.label: Contract and provenance
stages.description: Reject malformed, unlicensed, or untraceable records before expensive content work.

stages.label: Exact and near duplicate
stages.description: Match normalized fingerprints or candidates and preserve the cluster decision.

stages.label: Language and content quality
stages.description: Apply the versioned quality model and route uncertain records for review.

stages.label: Safety and privacy policy
stages.description: Evaluate prohibited content and sensitive-data policy with the most expensive model.
